summary: Phase G bug-fix verification round. Verified all 6 reported items (nav/logo overlap, SHOP casing, footer QR, public QR endpoint, SHOP hover dropdown, mobile menu). All PASS.

bug1_nav_logo_overlap.detail: At 1920, 1440, 1024 (desktop): logo bbox and each of HOME/SHOP/COLLECTIONS/ABOUT/JOURNAL/CONTACT have non-intersecting bounding boxes. At 768 and 390 (mobile): desktop nav is hidden and Menu hamburger does not intersect the centered logo.

bug2_shop_uppercase.detail: Desktop nav SHOP button textContent === 'SHOP' (all caps).

bug3_footer_qr.detail: [data-testid='footer-review-qr'] present. loads (naturalWidth=410). [data-testid='footer-review-link'] href=/review; clicking it navigates to /review and [data-testid='public-review-form'] renders.

bug4_public_qr_endpoint.detail: GET /api/reviews/generic-qr.png -> 200 OK, Content-Type: image/png, body size 820 bytes (>500), starts with PNG magic 89504E470D0A1A0A. No auth required.

bug5_shop_dropdown.detail: Hovering SHOP button opens dropdown; Drinkware and Clothing links visible. Clicking Drinkware navigates to /shop/drinkware.

bug6_mobile_menu.detail: At 390px, hamburger visible; on click, mobile drawer expands. Mobile SHOP link textContent='SHOP' (uppercase), href=/shop; clicking it navigates to /shop. Home/About/Journal/Contact links present with correct hrefs (/, /about, /blog, /contact).

critical_code_review_comments: Navbar uses a 3-column CSS grid (1fr_auto_1fr) which correctly prevents logo-nav overlap; solid architectural choice.
publicGenericQrImageUrl() correctly targets the new PUBLIC endpoint /api/reviews/generic-qr.png (not the admin-protected /api/admin/reviews/generic-qr/image.png).

backend /api/reviews/generic-qr.png depends on PUBLIC_APP_URL setting; if unset, QR encodes only '/review' (relative). Consider falling back to request.base_url so QR is always scannable. Non-blocking for this round.

Mobile menu Home/About/Journal/Contact links share href with desktop nav links; when using has-text selectors the first match may be the (hidden) desktop element. Not a bug — just note for future test scripts.
test_credentials: N/A — all verified endpoints/flows are public
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase G bug-fix verified. Nav uses grid layout; footer has global review QR block. Public QR endpoint at /api/reviews/generic-qr.png is unauthenticated. For future tests hitting mobile nav, scope selectors to `header .lg\:hidden a` to avoid matching hidden desktop counterparts.
